You can open it in the person's browser and fill in and submit the short form for them, using their own details, or give them the link.

tools.name: get_lender_score
tools.description: The FreeRateUpdate Score (0-100) for a verified, currently in-network lender by company NMLS id, with factor breakdown and methodology link. Companies without a published current Score are not found.

tools.name: get_network_rate_summary
tools.description: Network-aggregate advertised-rate summary (min/avg APR + distinct-lender count per product bucket, min 5 lenders per bucket) from the latest fresh FreeRateUpdate rate snapshot. Aggregates only — no per-lender rates.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_lender_universe · Private data: get_start_link · Public sink: get_start_link · Destructive: get_loan_limits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_lender_universe · Private data: get_start_link · Public sink: get_start_link · Destructive: get_loan_limits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_mortgage_rates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
